properties.name: Declared binary product law
properties.description: Three homogeneous task-conditional binary correctness variables; explicitly enumerated IID product masses. good > bad > 0. Common denominator (good+bad)^3; no dataset-average-to-IID inference.

properties.name: Correlation and denominator boundary
properties.description: Perfectly correlated outputs share the same normalized one-voter marginal as IID, via a proved cross-product identity, but majority adds no correct mass. This is a declared countermodel.

properties.name: Cost boundary
properties.description: An Int score-minus-cost witness only; no empirical cost model or equal-budget comparison.

properties.name: Finite realizable deterministic candidate pool
properties.description: The truth law is in the initial finite list and realizes every supplied outcome. N includes duplicate candidates. Step precedes filtering; at most N-1 mistakes. No new hypothesis generation, noisy-label or held-out monotonic theorem.

properties.name: Inconsistent feedback boundary
properties.description: A concrete incorrect outcome removes the initially present true law and worsens a future prediction. Outcome truth is a premise, not certified by an example type.

properties.name: Same graph reference-model dynamics
properties.description: Full four-member role-bearing graph candidates are retained. Small reference operators use endpoint reads and semantic rule payload. One forward map drives Step and candidate filtering; projections transfer the mistake bound. No durable-storage or real-LLM refinement.

properties.name: Computed semantic candidate update and exact whole-law gain
properties.description: Fixed true world and predeclared first/majority/alwaysTrue candidates. Feedback (false,true,true)->true selects pre-existing majority. Symbolic gain follows from product law; 18/27->20/27 is exact reference expectation, not measured gain. All truthful first observations are additionally checked at good=2,bad=1.

properties.name: Local prediction aggregation
properties.description: Use multiple local outputs under a declared role/context answer interpretation.

properties.name: Outcome-conditioned semantic candidate revision
properties.description: Retain alternative complete graph revisions and remove those incompatible with later outcomes.

properties.name: One evolving graph projection
properties.description: The selected graph relation controls subsequent forward behavior; learned candidates retain relation endpoints and role payload.

properties.name: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
properties.description: PaLM-540B GSM8K accuracy 56.5 to 74.4; 40 samples per run, 10 runs; greedy baseline is not compute matched.
properties.observation_limit: No universal task/model gain; decoding samples do not establish the homogeneous correctness law of this Lean model.

properties.name: TextGrad: Automatic Differentiation via Text
properties.description: GPT-3.5 forward/GPT-4o feedback; 36 training examples sampled with replacement, validation selection. Objects 77.8 to 91.9; GSM8K 72.9 to 81.1 ties DSPy.
properties.observation_limit: Prompt optimization observation; LLM feedback is not an independent truth certificate. No graph-learning or equal-budget theorem.

properties.name: Verbalized Machine Learning: Revisiting Machine Learning with Language Models
properties.description: Natural-language model parameters executed and revised through LLMs; failure cases, variability and context limits reported.
properties.observation_limit: Pretrained semantic parameter execution motivates a method; it does not prove the finite realizability premise or calibrated causal credit.

properties.name: Verbalized Particle Posterior: Bayesian Inference over Natural Language Hypotheses
properties.description: 2026 preprint with competing verbal hypotheses and VML x5 controls on small synthetic tasks.
properties.observation_limit: MH omits prior and reverse-proposal ratios, breaking exact detailed balance; SMC omits incremental ratios. Heuristic implementation is not an exact posterior theorem.

properties.name: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
properties.description: Evaluated intrinsic self-correction can fail or degrade reasoning without external feedback.
properties.observation_limit: Negative evidence within tested settings; not a theorem that all future self-correction fails.

properties.name: Hyperon: The Open-Source Infrastructure for Artificial General Intelligence
properties.description: Persistent metagraph with symbolic/neural and LLM integration is a direct architectural comparator.
properties.source_locator: Existing direct-prior audit and official whitepaper
properties.observation_limit: No novelty or superiority follows from names, architecture overlap or these finite HSWM proofs.

properties.name: Measure conditional joint errors
properties.description: Estimate joint failure patterns per task and role; independent calls and average accuracy do not establish IID. Fix answer equivalence and abstention rules.

properties.name: Refine reference operator to pinned real LLM
properties.description: Bind model, prompt, context, operator outputs and failures; show actual relation interpretation and candidate revision implement the declared dynamics.

properties.name: Qualify external feedback
properties.description: Bind pre-outcome predictions and later independent measurements; account for noise, missing feedback and dataset leakage. Do not promote self-evaluation to truth.

properties.name: Construct new useful semantic relations
properties.description: Replace the fixed truth-in-pool assumption with a justified candidate-generation/recovery mechanism that discovers variables, relations and topology.

properties.name: Test fresh cost-adjusted performance
properties.description: Use frozen/no/sham revision, plain context, self-consistency, TextGrad/VML/VPP and mandatory Hyperon controls where comparable; fix split and token/call budget before evaluation.

properties.name: Preserve learning under shared coupling
properties.description: Show multiscale Step/Learn and exception/uncertainty retention under shared causes; local improvement is insufficient.

properties.name: finite-selection
properties.description: Existing finite measured-score selection under an explicit uniform error bound; retained as a separate result.

properties.name: composition-interference
properties.description: Existing joint-interference counterexample: simultaneous local improvements can reduce global utility.
